messages.text:
Thanks for responding

At this point, I'm seriously losing confidence in Harlo's ability to actually produce and deliver the product I purchased back in July.

Between the repeated shipping delays, missed delivery estimates, lack of proactive communication, and changing product specifications, this entire experience has become incredibly frustrating.

When I originally placed my orders, I was impressed by the advertised specifications and believed I was purchasing a finished, production-ready product. Since then, the advertised power consumption has increased considerably, there are questions about whether the units will be cap····sustaining their full advertised 30 TH/s hashrate upon delivery, and now we're being told that Harlo OS won't even be available at launch, with no firm release date.

I understand that unexpected issues can arise during manufacturing and development. However, these are not insignificant changes, and they raise serious concerns about how thoroughly these units have been tested and validated before being shipped to paying customers.

Frankly, I'm beginning to feel as though I've paid a premium to participate as a beta tester on an unfinished prototype rather than purchasing the finished product that was originally advertised.

I sincerely hope these concerns prove to be unfounded, but the continued delays, changing specifications, and uncertainty surrounding the final product have made it increasingly difficult to maintain confidence in Harlo.

In the meantime, can we please verify that the warehouse has updated the shipping address for both of my orders?

Updated shipping address:

(address hidden)
(address hidden)

Order numbers: ···· and ····

Sarah previously confirmed that my address had been updated on the office side and told me I would receive a separate confirmation once the warehouse had updated its records.

However, I never received that confirmation.

Could you please verify directly with the warehouse that both orders have the correct shipping address and provide written confirmation before either order ships?

Thank you.

Hi Deren,

Thank you for laying this out so plainly. Your concerns are fair ones and I would rather give you an honest answer than a reassuring one.

On the address, I am the technical side of the team and I cannot see or edit orders myself, so I will not tell you something I have not verified. I have put both orders in front of a colleague who can read the warehouse record directly, and they are picking it up today, before either box moves. One thing I do need to point out while it is still open: the address you have written today is (address hidden), and the one you gave us on October 27 was (address hidden) Those are not the same street number. Please reply with the correct one and that is what will be confirmed back to you in writing on both orders.

On the specs, I am not going to quote you power figures or a Harlo OS date from memory, because a wrong number here is worse than none. I have passed your three questions to JD, our hardware lead: the revised power draw against what was advertised, whether shipping units hold a sustained 30 TH/s rather than a peak, and where Harlo OS actually stands for launch. He is the person with the bench data, and he will answer in this thread. What I can tell you with certainty is that the B30 is rated and warranted at 30 TH/s, so if a delivered unit does not hold its rated rate at stock settings, that is a warranty matter and we treat it as one, not as a beta quirk you are expected to live with.

If you want those answers faster than email, JD is very active on our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , where he is @nullhashrate. A good number of B30 buyers are in there comparing notes, and you are welcome to ask him directly.

Hal, HeliumDeploy Technical Support

Hi Hal,

Thank you for taking the time to address my concerns. I genuinely appreciate the straightforward response and your willingness to get some concrete answers rather than simply offering reassurances.

First, apologies for the confusion with the address. The correct shipping address for both orders is:

Since I never received that confirmation, I was concerned that the warehouse might still have my old address on file, especially after being told the orders were approaching shipment.

I just wanted to make sure we caught any potential discrepancy before the miners were shipped. I'd really appreciate confirmation that the warehouse has the correct address for both orders, ···· and ····.

I also appreciate you forwarding my technical questions to JD. I look forward to hearing his responses, particularly regarding the sustained hashrates and revised power consumption.

Thanks again for taking my concerns seriously.

Best regards
